name: cockpit
description: A live overview of the project and every Claude Code session, in place of the editor.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Cockpit shows every Claude Code session on this machine, with the worktrees, pull requests, CI and releases of this project, in the editor area.
[Open Cockpit](command:cockpit.open)

cockpit.openOnStartup.markdownDescription: Open Cockpit as the first, pinned tab when a window starts. Files you had open stay open beside it. Pair it with `#workbench.startupEditor#`: `none` so the Welcome page does not open too.

cockpit.claudes.showAllProjects.description: Show the Claudes of every project in the Claudes section. Off: only the Claudes of this window's project.

cockpit.endedSessionDays.description: How many days of ended Claude sessions to show.

cockpit.githubPollSeconds.description: How often to ask GitHub (through gh) for pull requests and CI runs while Cockpit is visible. Nothing is asked while it is hidden.

cockpit.hiddenSections.description: Sections of the Cockpit page to leave out.

cockpit.launch.model.description: The model "Start Claude…" on roadmap cards opens with.

cockpit.launch.effort.description: How much the Claude thinks (claude --effort): what "Start Claude…" opens with.

cockpit.launch.subagents.description: Up to how many subagents the Claude may run in parallel: what "Start Claude…" opens with. 0: it works alone.

cockpit.launch.subagentModel.description: The model every subagent runs on, when there are subagents: what "Start Claude…" opens with.

cockpit.launch.worktree.description: Start the Claude in a git worktree of its own: what "Start Claude…" opens with.

cockpit.launch.markDoing.description: Move planned cards to "In progress" once the Claude starts: what "Start Claude…" opens with.

cockpit.promptSteps.markdownDescription: **Per project**: read from the workspace's settings only, never the user's. The steps of the prompt a Claude started from the roadmap works by, one per item. Empty: Cockpit's standard steps. The steps that follow from the launcher's options (worktree or main checkout, committing, subagents) are added to them.

cockpit.release.versionFiles.markdownDescription: **Per project**: read from the workspace's settings only, never the user's. Files whose version **Release…** bumps, besides the root `package.json`, as paths from the repository root (for example `pyproject.toml`, `Cargo.toml`). In each, the first `"version"` key (JSON) or the first standalone current version is replaced.
